debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (recommended only for troubleshooting).

trusted_keys.description: List of base64-encoded Ed25519 public keys authorized to authenticate users. Each key grants root-level access.

max_concurrent_per_ip.description: Maximum number of simultaneous login attempts allowed from a single client IP address.

session_timeout.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before an authenticated session expires.

listen_addrs.description: Network addresses and ports on which the daemon listens for incoming connections.

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '::', '*').

port.description: TCP port number to listen on (1–65535).

valid_hostnames.description: List of allowed hostname values for incoming connections (used for host-based access control). If empty, any hostname is accepted.

enforce_rate_limit.description: Enforce rate limiting (e.g., max 5 attempts per minute) per client IP to mitigate brute-force attacks.

fallback_backend.description: Fallback authentication backend (e.g., 'none' for key-only auth, 'ldap', 'sqlite'). Use 'none' unless extended auth is required.
